title: The Alchemist
author: Paulo Coelho
summary: A young Andalusian shepherd has a recurring dream about treasure near the Egyptian pyramids and sets off across the desert to find it, meeting a series of guides and teachers along the way.
readIf: you want a quick, uplifting parable about following your dreams that you can finish in an afternoon.
skipIf: you prefer subtle writing, since the messages here are stated plainly and repeated.

pairings.reason: A deeper and more austere search for meaning, written in the same spare, fable-like voice.
Another story about a young man testing his faith and resilience on a long, strange journey.
A modern, accessible book that also asks what it means to choose a life that feels like yours.
